## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the commands/checks you ran and their outcomes. Explain any checks not run.

## Evidence and limitations

Include screenshots for UI changes, before/after examples, or experiment protocols as appropriate. Note configuration changes and external-service requirements.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] The change preserves authorization, draft approval, audit, and provenance behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant tests are updated, or I explained why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unrelated generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the project license and preserved third-party notices.
